gaps.explanation: Gap 940,000 is the Street Fund bond payment. The governmental funds statement p4 (printed p6) counts it among expenditures: Debt service Principal 1,070,000 = Street Fund 940,000 + Debt Service Fund 130,000 (Total expenditures 2,351,842). The Street Fund Budgetary Comparison Schedule p10 (printed p22) prints the same payment under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES as 'Bond payments (940,000)' (Net other financing sources 605,000 = Bond proceeds 1,545,000 - 940,000), not among its expenditures (Total expenditures 824,950). That printed line is already in detail as other financing 'Bond payment' -940,000 (Street Fund, p10), so adding a 940,000 expenditure line would count the same money twice, and moving the line would relabel a printed line. All other governmental expenditure lines tie to p4 by fund (General 208,627, Street 824,950 + 940,000 = 1,764,950, Debt Service 26,473 + 130,000 + 15 = 156,488, Police 56,811 + Fire 43,460 + Library 35,942 + Park & Rec 85,564 = 221,777 Other Governmental). Schedule 1,411,842 + 940,000 = 2,351,842. No fix.

Proprietary statement p7 (printed p9, modified cash basis) Total operating expenses 528,696 = Water 269,179 + Sewer 187,118 + Garbage 72,399. Detail holds the Water/Sewer/Garbage budgetary schedules (pp17-19), whose object lines equal the p7 rows (Personal services, Contractual, Utilities, Repairs and maintenance, Other supplies and expenses) but print no Depreciation. Depreciation is printed per fund column on p7 and is in no detail line: added Water 50,178 + Sewer 58,165 + Garbage 499 = 108,842. Remaining difference: the Sewer budgetary schedule p18 prints 'Capital outlay' 6,755 (in detail, index of 'Capital Outlay: Utilities' 6,755), which the p7 statement does not print as an expense (capitalized; it appears as capital and related financing (6,755) on the p8 cash flows). Budget schedule vs statement, both printed; no fix for that part. Check: 426,609 + 108,842 = 535,451; 535,451 - 528,696 = 6,755.

gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (printed p7) 'Proceeds of refunding bonds' 1,545,000, Street Fund column only = debt_proceeds 1,545,000. Detail already has it in full: Street Fund budgetary schedule 'Bond proceeds' 1,545,000 (p10, other financing). The non-transfer other-financing detail total is 605,000 because the same schedule also prints 'Bond payments' (940,000) under other financing (detail 'Bond payment' -940,000), which the statement counts as Debt service Principal (p4 Street Fund 940,000; see the governmental expenditure entry). 1,545,000 - 940,000 = 605,000. Same money, printed in another section; no fix. No other non-zero other-financing row of a fund column is missing (transfers General (226,000), Debt Service 37,443, Police 42,000, Fire 30,000, Library 38,000, Park & Rec 116,000, Sewer 10,000 / (37,443), Garbage (10,000) are all in detail) and no transfer line is labelled the wrong way round.
